ops.text: Two gaps sit downstream of the package-install fix (v0.52.0), both newly reachable rather than newly broken -- before it, neither bug could be reached at all. First, ApplyPackage forks Install/Supersede on os.Lstat but never quiesces the running installed generation, so superseding over a live launchd-managed helper refuses with "deploy: live processes remain on the deployment's executables: pid N .../CCNotesHelper" and the operator has to launchctl bootout com.yasyf.cc-notes.helper.fusekit by hand first. captain-hook's equivalent (internal/hookd/deployment.go applyPackagedApplication) calls quiesceInstalledApplication before landing, driving the PACKAGED app's stop entrypoint so the controller is never inside the bundle the inventory must find empty; cc-notes relies on deploy.Supersede's own quiesce, which does not take the LaunchAgent down. Second, once the generation does land and the agent runs, validateActivation still fails with "daemonkit returned an inexact readiness proof". The build ids match exactly (FUSEKIT_BUILD_ID and version.String() are both "v0.52.0 (85f31ca...)"), so the empty half of that OR is Readiness.Generation()/Digest(): the FuseKit runtime never completes its mount, logging "FuseKit runtime: read desired topology changes: context deadline exceeded" and leaving ~/CCNotes empty. That topology timeout is older than this work -- it is the first line ever written to ~/.cc-notes/fusekit-v1/holder.log, at 02:08:40, under the previous release. So package install now lands, activates, and records a live generation, but reports failure until the mount comes up.
